record.scope: MIMIKYU and MIMIKYU_BUSTED (3 stars, maxPP 40, range 1) declare SHADOW_SNEAK; their passives are MIMIKYU / MIMIKYU_BUSTED. This record covers only the strategy; the passives are separate queue records and are not described here.
record.summary: Single-target hit on the cast target: raw 25/40/50/100 by caster stars (both listed units are 3 stars, so 50). If the target has status.silence the damage type is TRUE (skips the SPE_DEF division and the damage-reduction items/effects), otherwise SPECIAL. The raw amount goes through handleSpecialDamage, so AP scales it by (1 + AP/100) and the cast's crit flag adds the crit factor only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT). The returned takenDamage is ignored: no heal, no status.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the inherited default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read here.

effects.damageType: SPECIAL, or TRUE when target.status.silence is set at the moment of the cast
effects.scaling: requested = raw x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults true in handleSpecialDamage) [x (1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor) if the cast crit; Rocky Helmet negation applies only when the type is not TRUE, Black Augurite reduction likewise]. Other factors inside handleSpecialDamage (DOUBLE_DAMAGE, STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT x1.2) apply to either type.
effects.resolution: SPECIAL: divided by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF) (armorReduction halves SPE_DEF, WONDER_ROOM swaps DEF and SPE_DEF), then damage-reduction items/effects, ceil, minimum 1, shield step. TRUE: reducedDamage = damage, the division and the reduction items/effects are skipped, but ceil, minimum 1 and the shield step still apply. A target with protect, skydiving or magicBounce takes 0 (magicBounce reflects only for SPECIAL type, so a silenced target's TRUE hit is not bounced). Power Lens retaliation only fires for SPECIAL. takenDamage (shield part plus HP lost) is returned and discarded by this strategy; see knowledge core-mechanics section J.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 1/2/4-star values (25, 40, 100) are not reachable by these units' bare star counts.

record.positionalConditions: The only condition is target.status.silence at the time of the cast (silenced target: TRUE damage).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast re-checks the silence status.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw 25/40/50/100 by caster stars (50 for both listed units). Requested = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor]. Applied against a non-silenced target = requested / (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF) (ceil, at least 1) and shield handling; against a silenced target the division is skipped (TRUE). The returned takenDamage is not used.
